control_issue.title: [Claude x Jules loop prod-c1] control: checkpoints and stop switch
control_issue.body:
Control issue of the Claude x Jules campaign prod-c1.

* Loop checkpoints are recorded here (no action needed).
* **Stop switch:** close this issue or add the label `loop-stop`. New Jules starts stop; running work continues. Reopen / remove the label to resume.
* Usage limits: a `claude-jules-quota v1` record here makes the loop wait for the reset.

This issue is not a task. Do not add the `jules` label to it.

signals.summary: test_blue_review_delivery_prepare.py: read_text() without encoding fails on Windows (cp932)
signals.detail: `automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_review_delivery_prepare.py` line 277 reads .github/workflows/blue-work-reconcile-static.yml with `Path.read_text()` and no encoding. That file contains non-ASCII UTF-8 text, so on Windows (default encoding cp932) the read raises UnicodeDecodeError or decodes wrongly; on Linux it passes. The same pattern failed on Windows in PRD-002 (main 702497c); this file itself has not been run on Windows yet.
evidence: automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_review_delivery_prepare.py:277 read_text() without encoding of a non-ASCII file (detected by an instrumented test run on main 4bb5cd7, 2026-10-10)
PRD-002 (campaign prd-c2): the same pattern failed on Windows with UnicodeDecodeError cp932
acceptance_criteria: Every Path.read_text() and open() for reading text in test_blue_review_delivery_prepare.py passes encoding='utf-8'
A regression test in test_blue_review_delivery_prepare.py fails if a read_text() or open() without an encoding comes back
No other file changes; no existing test is removed, skipped or weakened
